kitDescription: Belorta: Pumpkin Witch is a rocket-launcher Water supporter with a Burst II on a 40-second cooldown whose whole kit buffs exactly one teammate: the ally standing directly to her right. Every time the team enters Full Burst she puts on a Ghost Costume (untargetable by single-target attacks for 10 seconds, lost if she takes a direct hit), gains a small Max HP bonus, and hands the right-hand ally a flat ATK bonus worth 44.88% of her own ATK for 10 seconds. While the costume is on, each full-charge rocket she lands marks the boss so it takes 10.56% more damage from everyone for 10 seconds; costume or not, every full-charge shot also gives the right-hand ally a 5-second Sustained Damage boost. Her own Burst gives that same right-hand ally another 10-second flat ATK bonus (47.52% of her ATK) plus a stronger 10-second Sustained Damage boost. She deals no skill damage of her own; her value is positional and is strongest next to a damage-over-time carry.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA survives: all seven modeled lines are FAITHFUL (trigger identity, target set, gate, stat bucket, duration all agree with the prose and the formula SSOT) and the two defensive clauses are DOCUMENTED_GAPs with estimate + recipe + tier. The blind re-derivations converged mechanically: the S6 blind override is block-for-block identical to the shipped one, and my own trace of the S5 blind file against the shipped override reproduces the driver's self-report exactly (unmodified 8 RED, all from the blind file's `opts.onEvent` wiring defect; adapted 3 RED, all in the burst group because controlComp seats crown (B2, cd 20s) ahead of her so she never casts there — the blind writer's own burstFirst probe is GREEN and non-vacuous). The driver's fixture fixes that contest (she sits ahead of crown, casts ≥2, ≥1 FB without her cast) so the burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter split, the ungated-vs-gated skill2 headers, the single right-slot target, and the rightmost-slot edge are each pinned against a named nearest-wrong counterfactual that fails. The new `adjacentAlly` engine target kind is minimal (ownerIdx±1, nobody at the edge) and board-inert. Nothing must change for GO. Same-model residuals for the owner to spot-check: (1) no positive consumer test for sustainedDamagePct — the fixture's right ally has no sustained-flavor damage, so the routing into the DamageUp bucket is trusted from the shared engine primitive, not demonstrated here (recipe: patch scarlet with a flavor:'sustained' rider and confirm the multiplier rises by 19.97/27.23 pts); (2) casterAtkPct resolves against her STATIC ATK in the event value, which all agents assumed and the test pins — if the game's 'of the skill user's ATK' ever proves to include in-battle buffs, that is an engine-wide convention change, not this unit's; (3) ⚑1 remains the only live-play optimism (Ghost Costume never breaks early in v1).
